card.name: Disease definition noun after 'is a'
card.fires_on: The noun or verb that starts a dictionary-style definition of a disease or condition, such as 'is', 'infection', 'disorder' or 'illness' right after the term being defined.

modes.label: Category noun in definition
modes.description: The noun naming the type of illness, right after 'is a/an' plus an adjective.
